name: hermes
tagline: An assistant that phones businesses for you to book appointments or order food.
problem: Booking calls interrupt work, involve hold times and phone menus.
solution: Takes a plain-language request, searches and evaluates local businesses, and places the call with a voice agent to complete the booking or order.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask for a haircut tomorrow afternoon and hear the agent book it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Does a real-world phone task end to end.

lessons: A live call to a real business is a demo nobody forgets.
